title: Pre-proof hook validates only the files a commit authors

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Last commit on this branch touching a non-proof path. merge_sha is null pre-merge as the shared evidence contract requires (CEP-E7); it is bound to the real merge commit by post-merge-lane-close.yml. The MERGE_SHA: anchor in verification.md and diff-summary.md carries this branch anchor so the rebinder can find and rewrite it.

verdict.statement: The pre-proof validator now validates the files a commit authors rather than every staged path. Inherited-unchanged content is exempt; every other path -- including a conflict resolved to bytes equal to one parent, a post-merge edit, a delete, and a rename -- is still validated. Three pre-existing fail-open gaps were closed and one detection regression introduced by the rewrite was found in adversarial review and fixed in-lane.
